gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Powerful and a bit ancient, Nordic sets its letters far apart in one monoweight stroke, tight and closed in every opening. Noto Sans Buginese lets them breathe.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Blunt, ancient and carved-looking, Nordic holds every horizontal as heavy as its verticals, with its openings pinched shut. Noto Sans Buhid is the opposite, leaving generous space where its curves meet the stems, so a long page of text feels modern and unhurried.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-carian: Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, while Nordic bends wire-like letters with the cramped openings of a pressed leaf. Open against closed is the whole story.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Rope-thick and a little ancient, Nordic twists every stem, bowl and tail at the same weight. Noto Sans Chakma follows with approachable sans-serif letters packed close under the caps, its s and c left uncrowded.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-cham: Heavy, sparse and pinched shut, Nordic looks like something scratched into stone. And Noto Sans Cham reads easily after it, with open c shapes and tall rounded lowercase that keep a longer passage moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Nordic looks ancient and unshaded, every stroke the same and every opening closed. Noto Sans Cherokee sits beneath it as a tall band of approachable sans-serif letters, its e leaving a wide gap that eases the heading's tension.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-chorasmia: Noto Sans Chorasmian reads large and friendly, with a big x-height, short ascenders and curves that stop short instead of closing in. Nordic's neon-tube letters stay on top, so the page flows easily below.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Noto Sans Coptic reads with a dominant middle zone, its s and c left open and uncrowded for a clean, contemporary line. Give that sans-serif a comfortable size; Nordic can fend for itself.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Noto Sans Cuneiform has an e that opens up instead of closing its eye. Beneath Nordic, whose bowls are as heavy as its stems and whose letters stay shut tight, those swollen glass-bead lowercase forms feel like an exhale.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Noto Sans Deseret is approachable and clean, with open apertures and a wide-looking lowercase under squat ascenders. And Nordic, closed and monoweight, earns its keep big and brief, where its powerful, ancient look can land.
